description: This file defines the TextFragment class and related iterator class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides functionality for handling text segments, including indexing, comparison, trimming, and iteration over delimited text fragments.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with methods for comparison, trimming, and data access.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing text fragments separated by delimiters.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the TextFragment to an empty state.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a character at a specific index within the fragment.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality with another TextFragment, TCHAR array, or string.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality with another TextFragment, TCHAR array, or string.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the fragment is on a given marker.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the fragment is empty.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the text fragment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer of the fragment.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the fragment as a std::string.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares text with optional case sensitivity.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a delimiter or character.

methods.name: ForwardSkip
methods.description: Skips characters until a non-delimiter is found.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a delimiter.
